name: matrix_names_r1
description: Name-scheme test on Gemma 3 1B IT: the pilot's instruction-tuning intervention runs repeated on a renamed copy of the data, new invented names for 24 of 40 assets and ticker prefix ZQXV (mapping r1_coined). Texts, schedules, item order, seeds and settings are those of matrix_m1; only the asset names and tickers differ. Purpose: see whether the on-target minus off-target effect depends on the name tokens. Exploratory; two seeds.
comparison: matrix_m1 and matrix_m1_stage1, seeds 101 and 102, instruction-tuning intervention arm, same questions under the original names
deviations_from_design: settings as matrix_m1 (learning rate 1e-4, five-pass parent)
identifiers replaced by scripted substitution; collision checks on the new identifiers are model-run and not cleared
token records and schedules rebuilt from the renamed copy; paired token budgets not enforced
judge is one uncalibrated Haiku reader per response
